schema:
CREATE TABLE Employees (emp_id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, hire_date DATE NULL, status TEXT NULL);
CREATE TABLE Reviews (emp_id INTEGER NULL, review_date DATE NULL, score INTEGER NULL, FOREIGN KEY (emp_id) REFERENCES Employees (emp_id));
correct_query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.emp_id) FROM Employees AS T1 INNER JOIN Reviews AS T2 ON T1.emp_id = T2.emp_id WHERE T1.status = 'active' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.review_date) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.hire_date) >= 1

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Mutant omits the status filter predicate and changes INNER JOIN to LEFT JOIN under a cross-column STRFTIME year difference filter
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.emp_id) FROM Employees AS T1 LEFT JOIN Reviews AS T2 ON T1.emp_id = T2.emp_id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.review_date) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.hire_date) >= 1

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Mutant computes elapsed years using JULIANDAY difference divided by 365 instead of unadjusted STRFTIME('%Y') difference across two date columns
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.emp_id) FROM Employees AS T1 INNER JOIN Reviews AS T2 ON T1.emp_id = T2.emp_id WHERE T1.status = 'active' AND (JULIANDAY(T2.review_date) - JULIANDAY(T1.hire_date)) / 365.0 >= 1
